# Stochastic

The `stochastic()` is a generic S3 function that builds upon
'type-safe'-esque workflows limited to classes in in base `R`, and the
package-wide dependencies. Ie.
[class](https://rdrr.io/r/base/class.html) in,
[class](https://rdrr.io/r/base/class.html) out. Each method is a soft
wrapper of [model.frame](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/model.frame.html) and
therefore the OHLC-V series must be coercible to a
[data.frame](https://rdrr.io/r/base/data.frame.html).

### Handling of -values

`stochastic()` iterates over valid values, and returns `NA` for the
remaing part of series.

## Usage

``` r
stochastic(
  x,
  cols,
  fastk = 5,
  slowk = SMA(n = 10),
  slowd = SMA(n = 8),
  na.ignore = FALSE,
  ...
)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  An OHLC-V series that is coercible to
  [data.frame](https://rdrr.io/r/base/data.frame.html).

- cols:

  ([formula](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/formula.html)). An optional `3`
  variable [formula](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/formula.html) passed into
  [model.frame](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/model.frame.html). Internally
  uses `~high + low + close` by default.

- fastk:

  ([integer](https://rdrr.io/r/base/integer.html)). Period for the
  fast-k line.

- slowk:

  ([list](https://rdrr.io/r/base/list.html)). Period and Moving Average
  (MA) type for the slow-k line.
  [SMA](https://serkor1.github.io/ta-lib-R/reference/simple_moving_average.md)
  by default.

- slowd:

  ([list](https://rdrr.io/r/base/list.html)). Period and Moving Average
  (MA) type for the slow-d line.
  [SMA](https://serkor1.github.io/ta-lib-R/reference/simple_moving_average.md)
  by default.

- na.ignore:

  ([logical](https://rdrr.io/r/base/logical.html)). A
  [logical](https://rdrr.io/r/base/logical.html) of
  [length](https://rdrr.io/r/base/length.html) 1.
  [FALSE](https://rdrr.io/r/base/logical.html) by default. If
  [TRUE](https://rdrr.io/r/base/logical.html) 's are ignored during
  calculation to avoid returning `x` filled with 's.

- ...:

  Additional parameters passed into
  [model.frame](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/model.frame.html)

## Value

An object of same [class](https://rdrr.io/r/base/class.html) and
[length](https://rdrr.io/r/base/length.html) of `x`:

- SlowK:

  [double](https://rdrr.io/r/base/double.html)

- SlowD:

  [double](https://rdrr.io/r/base/double.html)

## Author

Serkan Korkmaz

## Examples

``` r
## load Bitcoin (BTC)
## series
data(BTC, package = "talib")

## calculate the indicator
## for Bitcoin (BTC)
output <- talib::stochastic(BTC)

## display the results
utils::tail(output)
#>                        SlowK    SlowD
#> 2024-12-26 01:00:00 43.41195 52.29321
#> 2024-12-27 01:00:00 38.22778 49.22312
#> 2024-12-28 01:00:00 40.68228 46.42570
#> 2024-12-29 01:00:00 40.26691 44.30948
#> 2024-12-30 01:00:00 38.33132 42.56383
#> 2024-12-31 01:00:00 38.61201 41.61931

## visualize the indicator
## with talib::chart()
##
## see ?talib::chart or ?talib::indicator
## for more details
{
 ## chart OHLC-V
 ## series with talib::chart()
 talib::chart(BTC)

 ## chart indicator
 ## with default values
 talib::indicator(
     talib::stochastic
 )
}
```
